name: random_number
description: Generate random values: integers, floats, choices from a list, random strings, and UUIDs. Run it with: node <install-folder>/cli.js --request '<json>' (install-folder is the agentic-random/ folder, e.g. ~/.claude/skills/agentic-random or ~/.config/opencode/plugins/agentic-random). stdout is a single JSON object {ok, tool, values, params}. Exit code 0 = ok, non-zero = error (the JSON has an 'error' message). Uses Math.random(), so results are not reproducible across calls.

low.description: Minimum value, inclusive (integer: default 0; float: default 0).

high.description: Maximum value, inclusive (integer: default 100; float: default 1).

decimals.description: Round floats to this many decimals (random.float only).

items.description: Comma-separated population for random.choice, e.g. "red, green, blue".
